name: ModuleHub
description: CWP widget platform for sandboxed industrial modules — load and run ModuleHub modules with live OMI data or simulation fallback
author: IS Control Room

properties.name: defaultModule
properties.description: ID of the module to load on startup (must match a folder in modules/)

properties.name: theme
properties.description: Visual theme passed to the shell and all loaded modules

properties.name: storeUrl
properties.description: REST endpoint for the ModuleHub store service (empty = IndexedDB-only local mode)

properties.name: storeKey
properties.description: X-Api-Key header value for the store service (empty = auth disabled)

properties.name: canEdit
properties.description: Show the Studio button in the header — bind to an OMI role expression to gate per user
